Planning Gate.rationale: Plan of 25 tasks in 11 waves traces every scope item S-001..S-015 and scope criteria 1..34 (cited SC-01..SC-34 to avoid colliding with the plan's assumptions A-001..A-014, per Finding 6); validation 45/45. Q-001: accepted; T-025 (commit, push, compare link) and the single live read are orchestrator closing acts at documentation-and-release-handoff. Q-002: confirmed; verification tasks are owned by dev-2-reviewer, qa decides the Review and Verification Gates on that evidence. Q-003: the orchestrator records the Browser-pane run of SC-34; dev-2-reviewer runs the automated headless browser tests and cites the orchestrator's record. Q-004: the architect answers in the design (expected yield of an unmodified read, paste mode as the expected common path if the real page is script-rendered); no forged signature or header is ever an option per CEO-D-1313.

Design Gate.rationale: CEO-D-1315: D-001 read inside the web app behind the MC-17 guard (O-001), one read at a time, block/sign-in/CAPTCHA/unreadable stops with no retry and offers paste mode; Q-004 every specification offered, operator keeps up to three rows (unchanged MC-16 check); Q-001 honest user agent 'MediaCompanyPilot/1.0 (doc-trang-san-pham)' (D-002); Q-002 switch off by default, turned on in the new settings view (D-003); Q-003 image hosts shopee.vn and *.susercontent.com, image files of the supplied product only (D-005); D-001 to D-006 accepted. Q-005 and Q-007 decided by the orchestrator for qa: the read log paired with the socket harness is accepted as SC-25 evidence; the SC-34 Browser-pane run uses the test program's local fixture host. Q-006 is answered by the orchestrator's single live read on a CEO-named link.
